title: The Household Excess on Spoiled Food under a ShieldCare Plan
content:
The excess the household carries on spoiled food is read from two things on the Northbeam ShieldCare
Protection Plan: whether any claim deductible, the excess the customer pays toward an approved claim, stands unsettled on the plan, and how many claims stand
decided on it inside the last 12 months.

A claim deductible stands unsettled on the plan where the excesses billed on it come to more than the
excess payments received against them.

| What the plan shows | The household's excess on spoiled food |
| --- | --- |
| no claim deductible stands unsettled on the plan, and fewer than 2 claims stand decided on it inside the last 12 months | nothing |
| no claim deductible stands unsettled on the plan, and 2 or more claims stand decided on it inside that time | 15.00 |
| every other plan | 30.00 |

### Both sides of the claim count

Exactly 2 claims decided inside the last 12 months is 2 or more, and carries an excess of 15.00; a
single claim decided inside that time is fewer than 2, and carries nothing. Where any claim deductible stands unsettled on the plan, neither of the first two rows is reached and the excess is 30.00,
however few claims have been decided.

### Cases on hypothetical records

| Deductible standing unsettled | Claims decided in the last 12 months | The household's excess |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 99.00 | 3 | 30.00 |
| 99.00 | 1 | 30.00 |
| none | 3 | 15.00 |
| none | 1 | nothing |
